defs.def: to divide, or to make a group of people divide, into smaller groups that have very different opinions 分裂，使分裂（成不同的派别）

ex.s: The first time I observed the process of water being split into oxygen and , I was deeply attracted by the charm of chemistry.
ex.t: 我第一次观察到水被分解成氧的过程，我被化学的魅力深深吸引。

ex.s: We started flying around the world, launching satellites into 1o orbit and, at the same time, scientists figured out how to split the atom, previously thought to be the smallest particle of matter in the universe.
ex.t: 我们开始环绕世界飞行，将卫星发射到1o轨道上，同时，科学家们想出了如何分割原子，之前被认为是宇宙中最小的物质粒子。

ex.s: Whether there are few or many people in your group, don’t split up.

defs.def: to divide, or to make sth divide, into two or more parts 分开，使分开（成为几个部分）
to divide sth into two or more parts and share it between different people, activities, etc. 分担；分摊；分享

ex.s: By splitting the rent with a roommate.
Today’s children spend an average of four and a half hours a day looking at screens, split between watching television and using the Internet.
ex.t: 如今的孩子每天花在屏幕前的时间平均为四个半小时，分为看电视和上网。

defs.def: to tear, or to make sth tear, along a straight line （使）撕裂
to cut sb's skin and make it bleed 划破；割破；碰破
to leave sb and stop having a relationship with them （和某人）断绝关系，分手；离开（某人）
to leave a place quickly （迅速）离开，走
a disagreement that divides a group of people or makes sb separate from sb else 分歧；分裂；分离
a division between two or more things; one of the parts that sth is divided into 划分；分别；份额
a long crack or hole made when sth tears 裂缝；裂口
a sweet dish made from fruit, especially a banana cut in two along its length, with cream, ice cream, etc. on top 香蕉船，水果船（将香蕉等纵切成条状作底，上覆奶油或冰淇淋等）
a position in which you stretch your legs flat across the floor in opposite directions with the rest of your body vertical 劈叉
